name: dev
description: YS-Codebase Developer Tools (Scaffold, Checker, Builder, Tester, Releaser)
onboarding: Create a new module scaffold: python yscb.py dev create <module-name> --desc="My module"
Run compliance static checks: python yscb.py dev check --all
Run isolated sandbox tests: python yscb.py dev test --all --quiet

release.summary: 對齊 dev 隨包手冊與技能文檔之雙軌釋出元數據、index-patch 與專案限定 @build 自部署建議
